AspendoraIdentity.ReportDocumentation: Visitors identified by email (form submits, email-campaign clicks, logins), enriched from GoHighLevel and scored 0–100. Score: up to 40 for visits, up to 40 for page views, +15 for activity in the last 7 days, +25 for viewing high-intent pages in the last 30 days. Leads at or above the hot threshold are tagged 'website-hot-lead' in GoHighLevel.
